extractedFrom.game: index.html: SKILLS evaluated from const CD to const pm

notes: Directions and trajectories are retained; material groups are proposed production groupings.
Null audit/asset/layer fields are intentionally unresolved and must be filled from real code during implementation.
Declared hits may be stopped early on death; multiple declared hits are resolved synchronously, not independently scheduled visual events.

observed.gameDescription: Three focused fire hits.
observed.currentFxDescription: Five turbulent flame bolts fall in quick succession with hot cores and separate ember contacts.

observed.gameDescription: Two focused arrow hits.
observed.currentFxDescription: Two visible arrows launch together along parallel paths with simultaneous contacts.

observed.gameDescription: Automatically heals below half health.
observed.currentFxDescription: A restorative cross resolves above the caster with gentle rising sage bands.

observed.gameDescription: A focused sword strike.
observed.currentFxDescription: A textured amber blade trail lands with a concentrated flare, fine sparks and a short pressure arc.

observed.gameDescription: An upward sword arc. Your next direct hit within 3 seconds deals 10% more damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: A bright orange blade rises from the ground in one sweeping uppercut.

observed.gameDescription: A challenge strike. Your next three direct hits within 3 seconds deal 10% more damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: A fiery challenge crest flares above the target in outward rays.

observed.gameDescription: Sweep nearby enemies with a broad sword strike.
observed.currentFxDescription: A tumbling orange crescent rolls from caster to target, scattering grit.

observed.gameDescription: Three quick sword thrusts against one enemy.
observed.currentFxDescription: A long, narrow orange thrust compresses through three tiny pressure collars.

observed.gameDescription: Increase sword attack speed.
observed.currentFxDescription: An orange speed crest and short afterimage chevrons resolve beside the caster.

observed.gameDescription: Five sword cuts against one enemy.
observed.currentFxDescription: One continuous orange corkscrew winds inward around the target, ending at the center. No repeated slash passes.

observed.gameDescription: Empower weapon attacks with a sustained aura.
observed.currentFxDescription: A textured amber weapon aura rises above an engraved seal with fine ascending embers.

observed.gameDescription: Chance to block physical hits while continuing to attack.
observed.currentFxDescription: Two crossed orange guards catch a localized parry spark.

observed.gameDescription: Three focused lightning hits.
observed.currentFxDescription: A branching electric discharge flickers through a white-hot core into a concentrated ground contact.

observed.gameDescription: Reduce incoming damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: A faceted blue barrier assembles around the caster, outlined by a pale edge and ground seal.

observed.gameDescription: A fire blast around the target.
observed.currentFxDescription: A rolling incandescent fireball leaves a turbulent wake, then blooms into a hot impact and drifting smoke.

observed.gameDescription: An icy impact and a follow-up pulse, with a brief chance to stun.
observed.currentFxDescription: Refractive ice shards form with a sharp frost impact, then wind-driven snow circulates around an open center.

observed.gameDescription: Four focused lightning hits.
observed.currentFxDescription: A turbulent charged orb follows its original flight path, then releases a branching electrical corona and shearing sparks.

observed.gameDescription: Meteors strike the target area twice.
observed.currentFxDescription: Fractured molten stones descend through turbulent fire, throwing incandescent fragments and smoke on impact.

observed.gameDescription: Earth erupts in a line through the target.
observed.currentFxDescription: A staggered wave of layered rock slabs pushes upward through cracks, grit and dust.

observed.gameDescription: A quick projectile powered by magic attack.
observed.currentFxDescription: A sharp violet magic splinter flies horizontally and shatters into a pressure star.

observed.gameDescription: A gravity impact and follow-up pulse. Pull nearby ordinary enemies together and briefly slow movement.
observed.currentFxDescription: Spiraling fragments feed a dark gravity core; two compressed pressure pulses pull light and matter inward.

observed.gameDescription: Increase spell damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: An engraved violet seal, hexagonal sigil and converging crystal motes gather at the caster.

observed.gameDescription: Four spectral hits with nearby splash damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: Five textured spectral pressure clouds detonate with staggered hot cores and fractured violet wakes.

observed.gameDescription: Increase attack speed.
observed.currentFxDescription: An eye-shaped focus lens opens beside the caster and resolves into precision ticks.

observed.gameDescription: A falcon strike with nearby splash damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: A feathered falcon follows a broad swooping attack path.

observed.gameDescription: A focused arrow marks the target. Your next three direct hits within 3 seconds deal 12% more damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: A contracting four-point reticle marks one fast, precise arrow.

observed.gameDescription: A heavy focused falcon strike.
observed.currentFxDescription: A feathered falcon dives in 0.34 seconds with swept wings and short velocity echoes.

observed.gameDescription: An arrow pierces enemies in a line.
observed.currentFxDescription: A heavier piercing arrow passes through the target and leaves a long exit slipstream.

observed.gameDescription: Increase critical chance.
observed.currentFxDescription: Three staggered vision lenses open beside a focused scanning cone.

observed.gameDescription: Automatically trap the target for 2 seconds. Bosses are rooted for 1.25 seconds, then resist roots for 3 seconds. Rooted enemies can still attack.
observed.currentFxDescription: A shaded metal jaw trap closes its teeth and restraints around the target’s feet.

observed.gameDescription: Two quick blade hits with a katar or dagger.
observed.currentFxDescription: One short dagger snap cuts across the target with a small, immediate contact.

observed.gameDescription: A direct slash that briefly reduces the target’s accuracy.
observed.currentFxDescription: A lateral decoy draws attention before a delayed reverse counter-cut lands.

observed.gameDescription: Eight focused blade hits with a katar or dagger.
observed.currentFxDescription: Eight textured violet and icy blade trails cross in rapid succession, each punctuated by a tight contact flash.

observed.gameDescription: A blade wave pierces enemies in a narrow line.
observed.currentFxDescription: A worm-like maw of 26 small hooked teeth erupts around the monster in two staggered rings, with inward cutting tips, broken earth and outward dust.

observed.gameDescription: Two cuts strike a small crossing area.
observed.currentFxDescription: Two long blades cross once into a clear X, then their edges peel apart.

observed.gameDescription: An immediate blade burst around you.
observed.currentFxDescription: Seven purple force blades explode radially outward from a violet core.

observed.gameDescription: A ranged blade-energy strike powered by physical attack.
observed.currentFxDescription: A wide crescent flies level toward the enemy, with its convex cutting edge facing forward and its sharp tips trailing behind. A beveled edge, fine wake and quick contact retain the 0.29-second flight.

observed.gameDescription: Strike and mark the target. The mark bursts after three more direct hits or 1.5 seconds.
observed.currentFxDescription: Four curse needles close around a diamond deathmark; the mark fractures outward.

observed.gameDescription: A focused holy beam that damages every enemy type.
observed.currentFxDescription: A slender ivory light shaft meets an engraved ground seal, with rising light motes and a warm contact flare.

observed.gameDescription: A holy impact with nearby splash. Successful hits also heal you when below 60% health.
observed.currentFxDescription: A rotating eight-point light flies horizontally, bursts into rays, then echoes a small heal at the caster.

observed.gameDescription: Increase your direct damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: A warm cross materializes over the caster while fine motes rise beneath it.

observed.gameDescription: Increase attack speed. At maximum attack speed, also increase direct skill damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: Two layered wing-like light fans unfurl beside the caster.

observed.gameDescription: A holy burst around the target.
observed.currentFxDescription: A gold double-ring seal expands beneath four staggered columns of holy light.

observed.gameDescription: A column of holy light hits the target and nearby enemies.
observed.currentFxDescription: A descending luminous veil resolves into a tall pillar with rising motes.

observed.gameDescription: Empower normal mace attacks with holy damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: An ivory sword glints beside the caster and releases a small weapon seal.

observed.gameDescription: A holy strike marks the target. Your next three holy skill hits within 3 seconds deal extra damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: Five sacred diamonds converge before a small cross-shaped punishment lands.

observed.gameDescription: A rapid sequence of focused holy beams.
observed.currentFxDescription: Six luminous projectiles converge from separate directions in a rapid barrage.

observed.gameDescription: Holy ground strikes immediately and pulses once more.
observed.currentFxDescription: An eight-point consecration seal illuminates the ground with raised light stations.

observed.gameDescription: Increase critical chance.
observed.currentFxDescription: An ivory halo and five ceremonial light motes rise over the caster’s inscribed ground seal.

observed.gameDescription: A heavy focused weapon hit.
observed.currentFxDescription: A strike knocks spinning gold coins out of the target; coins fall and bounce.

observed.gameDescription: Strike nearby enemies with a chance to briefly stun.
observed.currentFxDescription: A solid beveled bronze hammer accelerates into a grounded strike with compact debris and recoil.

observed.gameDescription: Increase attack speed.
observed.currentFxDescription: Four ascending amber force arrows and a brief pulse signal increased attack speed.

observed.gameDescription: A heavy strike. Your next three direct hits within 3 seconds deal 10% more damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: Cracks propagate through a shaded armor plate before it breaks into four pieces.

observed.gameDescription: A heavy focused cart impact.
observed.currentFxDescription: A shaded wooden cart rolls forward on metal-rimmed wheels and lands a compact physical impact.

observed.gameDescription: Empower physical attacks. Replaces Overthrust while enabled.
observed.currentFxDescription: Three stacked amber power bands rise around a compact force emblem.

observed.gameDescription: Increase travel speed.
observed.currentFxDescription: A compact induction pad energizes twin amber exhaust trails and acceleration ticks beneath the caster. No floating wheel symbols.

observed.gameDescription: A short burst of increased damage.
observed.currentFxDescription: Rough orange flame tongues and a jagged crest surge upward around the caster.

observed.gameDescription: A short burst of increased physical attack with katars or daggers.
observed.currentFxDescription: Two violet blade silhouettes flank the caster above fine poison diamonds.

observed.gameDescription: A burst of increased physical attack.
observed.currentFxDescription: Six amber force nodes gather around a hexagonal power crest.

observed.gameDescription: A fiery sword burst around you.
observed.currentFxDescription: A low orange flame front ignites around the target and dissolves into smoke.

observed.gameDescription: An icy hit with a chance to briefly stun.
observed.currentFxDescription: A refractive frost spear skims the ground and strikes into a crystalline freeze with flying ice chips.

observed.gameDescription: A lightning field strikes and pulses once more.
observed.currentFxDescription: Orange lightning branches strike under a low thundercloud bank with individual amber contacts.

observed.gameDescription: A fan of arrows strikes enemies in front of you.
observed.currentFxDescription: Twelve beveled arrows rain down across a broad area, each with its own compact metal contact and dust response.

observed.gameDescription: A fan of blades strikes enemies in front of you.
observed.currentFxDescription: Five visible blades launch from the caster in a spreading fan.

observed.gameDescription: A fan of holy light strikes enemies in front of you.
observed.currentFxDescription: A tall ivory crescent sweeps sideways across the target, shedding warm motes.

observed.gameDescription: A cart sweep strikes nearby enemies.
observed.currentFxDescription: A gold-outlined cart sweeps around the target on a curved ground path, leaving a continuous amber skid trail and outward contact ticks.

observed.gameDescription: A quick sword strike. Deals 20% more damage if you were hit within the last 2 seconds.
observed.currentFxDescription: An orange guard catches a glancing blow before a short rising counter-thrust.

observed.gameDescription: A sword strike followed by a short bleed. Repeated bleeds refresh the effect.
observed.currentFxDescription: One heavy orange wound-cut leaves downward amber fracture wisps.

observed.gameDescription: Automatically place a mine at the target. The initial hit is followed by an explosion.
observed.currentFxDescription: A compact ground charge arms, flashes, and sends real fragments and dust upward.

observed.gameDescription: Increase travel speed.
observed.currentFxDescription: Long low wind slipstreams glide past the caster’s feet.

observed.gameDescription: Dash into melee and slash through enemies in a narrow line. Strike in place when already close.
observed.currentFxDescription: A single hooded shadow afterimage lunges forward through a thin smoke wake, ending in one sharp piercing seam and drifting spectral fragments.

observed.gameDescription: Three focused cuts with a short dash when needed. Strike in place when already close.
observed.currentFxDescription: Three detailed spectral attack poses converge from separate directions in staggered thrusts. Their contacts fracture outward in three fine branches.

observed.gameDescription: A heavy holy strike. Deals 15% more damage below 30% target health.
observed.currentFxDescription: An ivory banishment star breaks into outward sacred motes.

observed.gameDescription: Strike with a holy seal that detonates after a short delay, damaging nearby enemies.
observed.currentFxDescription: A large twelve-point judgment seal gathers before a heavy central light descends.

observed.gameDescription: A heavy strike with nearby splash. Deals 12% more damage against a target marked by Armor Crack.
observed.currentFxDescription: An armor plate heats along a jagged fracture and sheds incandescent fragments.
